string.name: cancel_action_with_details
string.comment: %1$s=the word Cancel, %2$s=the active item being cancelled (e.g. a running temp basal or extended bolus description). Example: 'Cancel 150% 30min'

string.name: values_with_plus
string.comment: Two items with a plus between them. Example: Bolus + Carbs, or 20 g + eCarbs 10 g / 3 h (+60 min)

string.name: status_age_short
string.comment: Age of a sensor, cannula or battery, short. d=days, h=hours. %1$d=days, %2$d=hours. Example: 2d5h

string.name: status_age_short_hours
string.comment: Age of a sensor, cannula or battery, short, used on the first day when there are no full days yet. h=hours. %1$d=hours. Example: 5h

string.name: agp
string.comment: Section title: Ambulatory Glucose Profile

string.name: agp_hours
string.comment: %1$d=number of hours. Example: 24h

string.name: agp_days
string.comment: %1$d=number of days. Example: 7d

resources.string: Bu aralık için glikoz verisi yok.
AGP istatistikleri yüklenemedi. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.

string.name: agp_percentile_10_90
string.comment: Glucose percentile band from the 10th to the 90th percentile

string.name: agp_percentile_25_75
string.comment: Glucose percentile band from the 25th to the 75th percentile

string.name: agp_percent
string.comment: %1$.1f=percentage value. Example: 72.4%

string.name: agp_range
string.comment: %1$s=lower glucose value, %2$s=upper glucose value. Example: 3.9–10.0

string.name: agp_above
string.comment: %1$s=upper glucose limit. Example: > 10.0

string.name: agp_below
string.comment: %1$s=lower glucose limit. Example: < 3.9

string.name: agp_ea1c
string.comment: Estimated HbA1c

string.name: agp_gmi
string.comment: Glucose management indicator

string.name: agp_standard_deviation
string.comment: Standard deviation of glucose values

string.name: agp_cv
string.comment: Coefficient of variation of glucose values

string.name: agp_decimal
string.comment: %1$.1f=numeric AGP value without units, such as eA1c, GMI or days of glucose data. Example: 13.8

string.name: cgp_tor
string.comment: Glucose Pentagon axis: Time out of Range

string.name: cgp_cv
string.comment: Glucose Pentagon axis: Coefficient of Variation

string.name: cgp_hypo
string.comment: Glucose Pentagon axis: Hypoglycemia

string.name: cgp_hyper
string.comment: Glucose Pentagon axis: Hyperglycemia

string.name: cgp_mean_glucose
string.comment: Glucose Pentagon axis: Mean glucose

string.name: cgp_pgr
string.comment: Prognostic Glycemic Risk score label

resources.string: GTD istatistiklerini tekrar hesaplamak istiyor musunuz?
Lütfen miktarın infüzyon setinizin özelliklerine uygun olduğundan emin olun!
%1$s insülin adı zaten var, yeni bir ad seçin

Eşleştirilmiş bir istemci insülin yapılandırmasını değiştirdi. Onun değişikliklerini yüklemek ve kaydedilmemiş düzenlemelerinizi silmek için Tamam\'a, düzenlemeye devam etmek için Vazgeç\'e dokunun (bir sonraki kaydınız onun değişikliklerinin üzerine yazar).
Bu insülin başka bir yerde silindi, bu yüzden düzenlemeniz kaydedilemedi. Liste yeniden yüklendi.
%1$s uygulandı, ancak bazı işlemler uygulanamadı.\nEtkin durumu kontrol edin.
%1$s gönderildi, ancak onay gelmedi.\n%2$s\nAna birim uyguladığında burada görünecektir.

string.name: wizard_percentage_and_correction
string.comment: Bolus wizard result, shown after the amounts when both are changed. %1$s=percentage, %2$s=correction with its sign and unit. Example: 71% +1.00 U

string.name: wizard_calc_with_isf
string.comment: Line of the bolus wizard calculation. %1$s=what the insulin is for, %2$s=insulin sensitivity factor used. Example: BG (ISF: 3.0)

string.name: wizard_calc_with_ic
string.comment: Line of the bolus wizard calculation. %1$s=what the insulin is for, %2$s=insulin to carb ratio used. Example: COB (IC: 10.0)

string.name: wizard_calc_carbs_with_ic
string.comment: Line of the bolus wizard calculation for the carbs eaten now. %1$s=Carbs, %2$s=amount with unit, %3$s=insulin to carb ratio used. Example: Carbs 20 g (IC: 10.0)

resources.string: Tüm karbonhidrat hemen, yayma karbonhidrat yok

string.name: wizard_carbs_type_desc
string.comment: What the cake or pizza carb type does. %1$d=percent the carbs are reduced by, %2$d=percent added as eCarbs, %3$d=minutes until the eCarbs start, %4$d=hours they are spread over. Example: Carbs reduced by 10%, added eCarbs 20% delayed 60 min for 2 h

resources.string: Karbonhidrat %%%1$d azaltıldı, %%%2$d yKarb eklendi, %3$d dk gecikmeli, %4$d sa boyunca

Hesaplamaya dahil etmek/hariç tutmak için dokunun:
• KŞ — kan şekeri (başlangıçta AÇIK)
• GH — geçici hedef (başlangıçta AÇIK)
• Eğilim — KŞ eğilimi (son durum hatırlanır)
• AİNS — aktif insülin (başlangıçta AÇIK)
• AKRB — aktif karbonhidrat (son durum hatırlanır)

string.name: a11y_bg_graph_summary
string.comment: Screen-reader description of the glucose graph, which is drawn and so cannot be read otherwise. %1$s=the recent glucose values newest first, already joined and carrying their unit, %2$s=insulin on board with its label, %3$s=carbs on board with its label. Example: Glucose graph. Recent values 7.2, 7.0, 6.8. IOB: 1.20 U. COB: 45 g

string.name: a11y_show_controls
string.comment: Screen-reader name of the invisible area that brings back the top bar, menu and toolbar on a short screen, where they hide by themselves.

string.name: a11y_notifications
string.comment: Screen-reader name of the notification button on the main screen. %1$d=number of notifications. Example: Notifications: 3

string.name: a11y_tt_none
string.comment: Screen-reader state of the temp target chip when no temp target is running; the chip then shows the profile target.

string.name: a11y_tt_adjusted
string.comment: Screen-reader state of the temp target chip when the loop has changed the target; on screen this is only a colour.

string.name: a11y_profile_entry
string.comment: Screen-reader name of one value field in the profile editor. %1$s=the list it belongs to, with its unit (e.g. Basal [U/h]), %2$s=the start time of that entry. Example: Basal [U/h] at 08:00

string.name: a11y_bg_delta
string.comment: Screen-reader text for the change since the previous glucose reading. %1$s=the change with its sign and unit. Example: delta +0.3

string.name: a11y_bg_old_reading
string.comment: Screen-reader word added to a glucose reading that is too old to trust. On screen the value is struck through.

string.name: a11y_bg_age_old
string.comment: Screen-reader text for the age of a glucose reading that is too old to trust. %1$s=the age, %2$s=a11y_bg_old_reading. Example: (12 min), old reading

string.name: a11y_bg_graph_summary_values_only
string.comment: Same as a11y_bg_graph_summary but for the history browser, where insulin and carbs on board are current values and would be wrong beside a past day. %1$s=the glucose values newest first, already joined and carrying their unit.

string.name: a11y_predictions
string.comment: Screen-reader description of the predicted glucose curves, which are drawn on the graph and cannot be read otherwise. %1$s=one sentence per prediction, already joined. Example: Predictions. COB prediction rises to 11.2 mmol/l. IOB prediction falls to 4.8 mmol/l.

string.name: a11y_prediction_rises
string.comment: One predicted curve that ends higher than the current glucose. %1$s=the name of the prediction, %2$s=the highest value it reaches, with its unit. Example: COB prediction rises to 11.2 mmol/l

string.name: a11y_prediction_falls
string.comment: One predicted curve that ends lower than the current glucose. %1$s=the name of the prediction, %2$s=the lowest value it reaches, with its unit. Example: IOB prediction falls to 4.8 mmol/l

string.name: a11y_prediction_flat
string.comment: One predicted curve that stays level. %1$s=the name of the prediction, %2$s=the value it holds, with its unit. Example: Zero temp prediction stays at 6.1 mmol/l

string.name: a11y_prediction_name_iob
string.comment: Spoken name of the prediction from insulin on board. IOB is the term AAPS users know.

string.name: a11y_prediction_name_cob
string.comment: Spoken name of the prediction from carbs on board. COB is the term AAPS users know.

string.name: a11y_prediction_name_acob
string.comment: Spoken name of the prediction from already absorbed carbs, shown by the AMA algorithm only.

string.name: a11y_prediction_name_uam
string.comment: Spoken name of the prediction for a meal the user did not enter. UAM is the term AAPS users know.

string.name: a11y_prediction_name_zt
string.comment: Spoken name of the prediction for what happens with no insulin at all, the zero-temp curve.

string.name: a11y_badge_attention
string.comment: Screen-reader state of a navigation button that carries a warning badge. On screen the badge is a dot or an exclamation mark, which a screen reader cannot see at all.

string.name: a11y_badge_available
string.comment: Screen-reader state of a navigation button whose badge counts what the user can start right now. %1$d=the count. Example: 3 available

string.name: a11y_objectives_progress
string.comment: Screen-reader state of the Objectives navigation button, whose badge shows progress. %1$d=objectives finished, %2$d=objectives in total. Example: 9 of 10 done

string.name: execute_label
string.comment: Button that runs the selected quick wizard, which delivers its bolus.

string.comment: Short tab label on the Statistics screen. The tab shows daily insulin totals laid over 28-day cycles (TDD Cycle Pattern).

string.name: a11y_quick_launch_add
string.comment: Screen-reader label of the button that adds an action to the QuickLaunch bar. %1$s=the action name. Example: Add Bolus wizard

string.comment: Screen-reader label of the button that removes an action from the QuickLaunch bar. %1$s=the action name. Example: Remove Bolus wizard
